question: Using the bigquery-public-data.open_images dataset, can you provide a count of how many distinct image URLs are categorized as 'cat' (where the image has label '/m/01yrx' with confidence=1) and how many distinct image URLs are categorized as 'other' (meaning they have no cat label '/m/01yrx' at all)?
sql:
WITH cat_images AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT image_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.labels`
  WHERE label_name = '/m/01yrx' AND confidence = 1.0
),
images_with_cat_any AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT image_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.labels`
  WHERE label_name = '/m/01yrx'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.original_url) FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.images` i WHERE i.image_id IN (SELECT image_id FROM cat_images)) as cat_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.original_url) FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.images` i WHERE i.image_id NOT IN (SELECT image_id FROM images_with_cat_any)) as other_count
